created.description: Create a poll. 2 to 10 choices, at most 120 bytes each; expiry required.

choices.description: Poll choices, 2 to 10, at most 120 UTF-8 bytes each. The byte limit is enforced by the validator.

closes_at.description: Poll expiry, UTC whole seconds. Required.

multi_select.description: Whether multiple choices may be selected.

responded.description: Respond to a poll. Represents the agent unless human_confirmed is true with a local approval record.

human_confirmed.description: True only with a local human approval record.

poll_id.description: Lowercase canonical UUIDv4 of the poll.created event.

description: Poll payloads: poll.created, poll.responded. The envelope's protected event_type selects the variant.
title: Poll payloads
